## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Related request

Link the issue or change request.

## Scope

- [ ] Change is limited to the approved scope
- [ ] No unrelated files were modified
- [ ] No secrets or credentials were added

## Validation

- [ ] CI build passes
- [ ] Vercel preview reviewed
- [ ] Desktop view checked where relevant
- [ ] Mobile view checked where relevant
- [ ] Customer/product owner approval recorded where required

## Release

- [ ] Rollback point identified
- [ ] Production verification required after merge
